definitions.explanation: The part that is within or facing inward.

examples.japanese: ドアの{内側|うちがわ}に{鍵|かぎ}がある。
examples.english: There is a lock on the inside of the door.

examples.japanese: {箱|はこ}の{内側|うちがわ}を{確認|かくにん}してください。
examples.english: Please check the inside of the box.

examples.japanese: カーブでは{内側|うちがわ}を{走|はし}ると{早|はや}い。
examples.english: Running on the inside of a curve is faster.

notes:
{内側|うちがわ} refers to the inside, inner surface, or interior of something—the part that faces inward.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {内側|うちがわ}から{開|あ}ける: to open from the inside
- {内側|うちがわ}に{向|む}く: to face inward
- {内側|うちがわ}を{見|み}る: to look at the inside
- {内側|うちがわ}に{入|はい}る: to go inside

CONTRAST:
- {内側|うちがわ}: inside, inner side
- {外側|そとがわ}: outside, outer side

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {中|なか}: inside, within (more general)
- {内部|ないぶ}: interior (more formal/technical)
- {裏|うら}: back side, reverse side

USAGE:
{内側|うちがわ} specifically emphasizes the side or surface facing inward, rather than the space within. Use {中|なか} for referring to the space inside something.
